remarks: Here is an opportunity to own one of the most elevated new construction residences in Corona del Mar, defined by exceptional design, quality and attention to detail. Set on a full 40-foot-wide lot, the residence takes full advantage of its uncommon width, creating broader living spaces, greater volume and a sense of openness rarely found in an attached residence. Nearly 1,200 square feet of outdoor living is incorporated throughout the home, highlighted by a fully built-out rooftop deck of more than 650 square feet.
